quarterly_data.quarter: Honeywell press release: Honeywell Technologies Completes Sale of Productivity (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell Technologies completed the sale of its Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) business to Brady Corporation in an all-cash transaction (announced Aug. 3, 2026), following the completed sale of its Warehouse and Workflow Solutions business the month before. CEO Vimal Kapur: closing the PSS divestiture is the final step toward completing the transition to a pure-play automation company, fully focused on the building, industrial and process sectors.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: buyer of the Productivity Solutions and Services business
